snippet.title: Teardown Multiplayer & Mod Pack 6 Hit Consoles September 15th
snippet.description:
Teardown Multiplayer arrives on consoles September 15th alongside Mod Pack 6!

Team up with up to 12 players and experience Teardown’s fully destructible world Together. Play through the campaign in co-op, compete in modes like Deathmatch and Capture the Flag or jump into Sandbox Mode and turn every map into your own multiplayer playground.

More than 70 multiplayer-ready community mods will also be supported, bringing new maps, tools, vehicles, game modes, challenges and plenty of creative chaos to Multiplayer.

The Multiplayer Release includes multiplayer support for the following mods:

Mod Pack 1
- "Armanty Space Station" by Caffeine Power
- "Cliff House" by gusono
- "Colored Spraycan" by TTFH3500
- "Det Cord" by El_ttio
- "Drive Anything" by f1nniboy
- "Fire Fighter" by My Cresta
- "French Town" by lonardo & OzJackaroo
- "Hook Shotgun" by My Cresta
- "Inverted Pyramid House" by gusono
- "Lightning Ball" by Deffcolony & Oblomat
- "Plasma Rifle" by Oblomat
- "Vacuum Cleaner" by My Cresta
- "WTDN 12 News Studio" by ummm, i dont know :)

Mod Pack 2
- "AC130 Airstrike" by My Cresta
- "Cyberpunk City mini map" by Apholito12
- "Dragon's Breath Shotgun" by tislericsm
- "Fish Launcher" by Bingle
- "Lightning Gun" by Autumn, Oblomat, KBD2, Nolram12345 & Mr. Rubyyy
- "montagna del castello" by Klimber & Klumbart
- "Outpost" by HuntingFluff
- "Paint Bomb" by Bingle
- "Party House" by Caffeine Power
- "Piano Fall Weapon" by Jiffy UP
- "Sapphire Luxury Apartments" by Sys32
- "Throwing Knives" by sage

Mod Pack 3
- "FELL TITAN" by gl8zed
- "Haptic Chainsaw" by Sairsey
- "NorthPine Mall 2.0" by teamish
- "Off The Grid Cabin" by Jack
- "Public Library - Sandbox" by RevKestrel-9F
- "Simple Selfie" by Litttle_fish
- "UltraBurn" by SirMagicEarlobeTheFirst

Mod Pack 4
- "1960s Ranch House" by Nonya
- "Blink: Ultimate Teleportation" by slapsqueak
- "Casa De La Cultura" by DonVictor
- "Crescent Motel" by Nonya
- "Gravitizer" by Miyks
- "Meteor Storm" by Deffcolony & tislericsm
- "Rooftop Playa" by o_O-r.
- "TEARFALL Part 1 - Abandoned Frustrum" by Leek
- "Voxplosion" by tislericsm
- "Welding Tool" by ♥︎ Jaylin ♥

Mod Pack 6 includes 30 multiplayer supported mods:
1. "Abandoned Evertides" by Bugaragara
2. "Balloons" by ancientevil581
3. "Conquest" by Frostube
4. "[Dynamic Weather + Dynamic Time]" by QuadView
5. "FPV Drone Tool" by Okidoki
6. "Frontline" by Frostube
7. "Gwel Mall 11.1" by Gwel & Le lance Flamer
8. "Hunting Rifle Lasers" by ancientevil581
9. "Light Katana" by GalaxyPizza
10. "Lockelle Fishing village" by legobrick
11. "Mega Model Pack" by The Mafia
12. "NIMS Archeda 77" by G-Fifd 77
13. "Prop Hunt" by DimasVoxel & Luke Splyne
14. "Rocket" by Pufv & Edgymanx7
15. "[RSL] Battle Royale" by Reisaelin
16. "Russian Island 13" by Senya
17. "Service and Civilian Vehicle Pack Remastered" by Tortoise Work
18. "Smoke Grenade" by Яблоко вкусное яблоко
19. "Spawnable Fortifications" by fenbka
20. "The Eraser" by David
21. "Tornado mod" by Fishlabs GmbH
22. "[TOOL UPDATE] Rusting Cars" by Tortoise Work
23. "Treasure Hunters" by Shawn
24. "Tripmine" by ancientevil581
25. "Trouble in Teardown" by Tooneytunes, NeonChicken & Snailpower
26. "TurtleBravo's Armored Vehicles" by TurtleBravo85
27. "Unnamed Vehicle Pack Remastered" by Highexer
28. "VEHICLE SUMO" by Pufv & Edgymanx7
29. "What To Do Next" by ONSVRG
30. "Zombiedown - Multiplayer Survival" by む, nazu & Yuuni
